objective: Prevent maintenance runs from repeatedly selecting a previously known, unchanged, non-tool-executable residue as the primary engineering slice merely because it remains OPEN, while preserving fail-closed permission boundaries, explicit blocker reporting when material, and retry once capability, authority, target state or evidence changes.

roles_before.artifact: EXECUTION_FAST_PATH selects the smallest valid verification path and optimizes repeated work.
PROTOCOL requires assistant-created residue with blocked cleanup to remain an explicit unresolved blocker.
Permission/write gates remain fail-closed and cannot be bypassed for convenience.
Previously blocked cleanup must still be performed when a valid executable path becomes available.
Owners/live sources determine whether blocker capability or state has materially changed.
Recorded base SHA preserves complete pre-change executor behavior.

role_dispositions.destination: Fast Path explicitly defers unchanged known non-executable blockers and selects another useful executable slice or NO-OP/PASS.
A material blocker is still recorded and surfaced when it actually blocks the requested outcome.
No permission, write, safety, evidence or cleanup gate is weakened.
Deferred residue is retried when tool capability, authority, target state or other material evidence changes.
Current tools/owners are re-read only when needed to establish a material change; stale failure evidence is not promoted to current truth.
Reverting the Fast Path/guard/workflow/manifest delta restores base semantics without data migration.

capability_probes.assertion: A newly encountered blocker that materially prevents the requested outcome is still surfaced and stops unsafe execution.
A known unchanged non-tool-executable residue is not repeatedly selected as the primary slice merely because it remains OPEN.
External write, player-state and cleanup lifecycle gates remain unchanged.
A deferred residue becomes eligible again when capability, authority, target state or evidence materially changes.
Recorded base SHA remains the complete rollback point.

tests.expected: Known unchanged non-executable blockers are deferred and retried only on material change.
Real blockers and permission/safety gates remain explicit and fail-closed.
